solution.p: The set-builder notation tells us to graph all numbers less than or equal to -3\text{.} So the shading can start all the way to the left at -\infty and extend up to -3\text{.} There should be a bracket at -3 to indicate that -3 is included.

And we read the number line from left to right, with the shading extending to -\infty and going all the way up to -3\text{,} including -3\text{.} So in interval notation, the interval is {\left(-\infty ,-3\right]}\text{.}
